title: Stirling's Approximation
subtitle: Number Theory · Asymptotics
detail:
\[ n! \approx \sqrt{2\pi n}\left(\frac{n}{e}\right)^n \]

The relative error is \(O(1/n)\) — for \(n=10\) the approximation is accurate to within 1%. The more precise form is \(n!=\sqrt{2\pi n}(n/e)^n e^{\theta/(12n)}\) for some \(\theta\in(0,1)\). Essential in statistical mechanics (entropy of systems) and combinatorics (asymptotics of binomial coefficients).
